# igraph / basic_properties_directed

igraph's own fuzz target `basic_properties_directed` ([source](source/basic_properties_directed.cpp), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over igraph (igraph/igraph at e8e03b24).

Checks 4 properties (listed below); the first, a differential check: is_simple must equal !(has_multiple || has_loop): two independent predicate APIs must agree.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against igraph at commit e8e03b24 with 1 patch to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.
